steps.ask: What must P(A) × P(B) equal for the events to be independent? Work that product out and compare it with P(A ∩ B).
steps.title: Test the condition for independence

lines.text: $A$ and $B$ are independent if $\hl{1}{P(A)} \times \hl{1}{P(B)} = \hl{2}{P(A \cap B)}$.
This equals $\hl{2}{P(A \cap B)} = \hl{2}{\frac{1}{2}}$, so the condition holds.
Conclusion: $A$ and $B$ are independent.
